import pandas as pd, gzip
# parse headers for KLF4 and perhaps KLF genes
wanted=[]
with gzip.open('Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.cdna.all.fa.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('>'):
            parts=line.rstrip().split()
            tid=parts[0][1:]
            gene=''
            for p in parts:
                if p.startswith('gene_symbol:'):
                    gene=p.split(':',1)[1]
            if 'KLF4' in gene or gene in ['KLF1','KLF2','KLF3','KLF4','KLF5','KLF6']:
                wanted.append((tid,gene))
print('transcripts wanted', wanted)
a=pd.read_csv('outA/abundance.tsv',sep='\\t').set_index('target_id')
b=pd.read_csv('outB/abundance.tsv',sep='\\t').set_index('target_id')
for tid,g in wanted:
    print(g, tid, 'A', a.loc[tid,'est_counts'] if tid in a.index else None, 'B', b.loc[tid,'est_counts'] if tid in b.index else None)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import binomtest
x=pd.read_csv('gene_counts_abundance.tsv',sep='\\t')
x=x[['gene','count_A','count_B']]
# library sizes from kallisto counts total
N_A=x['count_A'].sum(); N_B=x['count_B'].sum()
print('lib',N_A,N_B)
rows=[]
for _,r in x.iterrows():
    k=r['count_B']; n=r['count_A']+r['count_B']
    if n<1: continue
    p=N_B/(N_A+N_B)
    # two-sided? use exact binomial test
    bt=binomtest(int(round(k)), int(round(n)), p=p, alternative='two-sided')
    fc=(r['count_B']+0.5)/(r['count_A']+0.5)
    rows.append((r['gene'], r['count_A'], r['count_B'], fc, bt.pvalue))
res=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['gene','A','B','FC','p'])
res=res.sort_values('p')
print(res.head(40).to_string(index=False))
PY"
